scope: SYNTHETIC evaluation corpus written for this repo; not real news. Fixed so retrieval scores are reproducible.

documents.title: Spot bitcoin ETFs record largest weekly inflow of the quarter
documents.summary: US-listed spot bitcoin exchange-traded funds took in fresh capital for a fifth straight week as institutional allocators added exposure.

documents.title: Bitcoin ETFs see heavy redemptions as investors pull money
documents.summary: Spot bitcoin funds reported net outflows for three consecutive sessions, the longest run of withdrawals since launch.

documents.title: Ether ETF applications approved by the securities regulator
documents.summary: The US securities regulator signed off on several spot ether fund listings, clearing the way for trading next month.

documents.title: Regulator rejects proposed solana fund, citing market surveillance gaps
documents.summary: A spot solana product was turned down after the agency said the underlying market lacked adequate surveillance-sharing agreements.

documents.title: Mid-sized exchange halts withdrawals after hot wallet breach
documents.summary: Attackers drained roughly 40 million dollars from an exchange hot wallet; customer withdrawals are paused while forensics continue.

documents.title: Exchange suffers six-hour outage during volatile trading
documents.summary: A matching-engine failure took a large exchange offline for six hours; the firm says no funds were lost and trading has resumed.

documents.title: Algorithmic stablecoin loses its dollar peg and slides to 60 cents
documents.summary: A yield-bearing algorithmic stablecoin broke its one-dollar peg overnight as holders rushed to redeem.

documents.title: Major fiat-backed stablecoin publishes reserve attestation
documents.summary: The issuer of the second-largest dollar stablecoin released an accountant's attestation showing reserves held mostly in short-dated Treasuries.

documents.title: Bitcoin block subsidy halves as network passes milestone block
documents.summary: The scheduled halving cut the new-coin reward paid to miners by 50 percent, tightening fresh supply.

documents.title: Miners sell reserves as hashprice falls to record low
documents.summary: Public mining companies sold more of their coin holdings to cover power costs after revenue per unit of hashrate dropped sharply.

documents.title: Ethereum upgrade cuts data fees for rollups
documents.summary: The network upgrade introduced blob space for layer-two rollups, lowering the cost of posting transaction data to the main chain.

documents.title: Ethereum validator exit queue lengthens after staking rule change
documents.summary: More validators requested to unstake following a protocol change, pushing the exit queue to its longest in a year.

documents.title: Central bank holds rates; risk assets including crypto rally
documents.summary: The central bank left its policy rate unchanged and signalled cuts later in the year, lifting equities and digital assets.

documents.title: Hotter-than-expected inflation print knocks bitcoin below key level
documents.summary: Consumer prices rose faster than forecast, pushing yields higher and sending bitcoin through a closely watched support level.

documents.title: EU crypto-asset rules take effect for service providers
documents.summary: The bloc's licensing regime for crypto-asset service providers came into force, requiring authorisation to serve customers across member states.

documents.title: UK regulator tightens rules on crypto promotions
documents.summary: Firms marketing crypto to UK consumers must now include risk warnings and a cooling-off period for first-time investors.

documents.title: Large holder moves 20,000 BTC from long-dormant wallet
documents.summary: On-chain analysts flagged a transfer from an address untouched for over a decade, sparking speculation about selling pressure.

documents.title: Exchange balances of bitcoin fall to multi-year low
documents.summary: The amount of bitcoin held on trading venues kept declining, which analysts read as holders moving coins into self-custody.

documents.title: Funding rates spike as leveraged longs pile into perpetual futures
documents.summary: Perpetual swap funding turned sharply positive, signalling crowded leveraged long positioning across major venues.

documents.title: Cascade of liquidations wipes out 1 billion dollars in leveraged positions
documents.summary: A sudden price drop triggered forced closures of leveraged trades worth about a billion dollars within an hour.

documents.title: Options open interest hits record ahead of quarterly expiry
documents.summary: Bitcoin options open interest reached an all-time high, with large positions clustered at round-number strike prices.

documents.title: Implied volatility collapses to lowest level in two years
documents.summary: Options markets are pricing unusually calm conditions, with thirty-day implied volatility at a two-year low.

documents.title: DeFi lending protocol exploited through oracle manipulation
documents.summary: An attacker manipulated a thin price feed to borrow far more than their collateral was worth, draining the protocol's pools.

documents.title: Cross-chain bridge pauses after suspicious transfers
documents.summary: A token bridge between two networks suspended operations after unexplained transfers were detected; the team is investigating.

documents.title: Payments firm adds stablecoin settlement for merchants
documents.summary: A large payments company now lets merchants receive settlement in a dollar stablecoin, aiming to cut cross-border costs.

documents.title: Asset manager tokenises money-market fund on public blockchain
documents.summary: A global asset manager launched a tokenised share class of a money-market fund that settles on a public chain.

documents.title: Solana network suffers block production halt
documents.summary: Validators stopped producing blocks for several hours due to a client bug before a coordinated restart restored the chain.

documents.title: Solana activity surges as memecoin trading booms
documents.summary: Daily transactions and fees on Solana jumped to records, driven largely by speculative memecoin trading.

documents.title: Court rules token sales on exchanges were not securities offerings
documents.summary: A federal judge found that programmatic sales of a token to retail buyers on exchanges did not constitute investment contracts.

documents.title: Exchange settles with regulator over unregistered lending product
documents.summary: A crypto exchange agreed to pay a penalty and shut down an interest-bearing product the regulator said was an unregistered security.

documents.title: Bitcoin hits all-time high above previous cycle peak
documents.summary: Bitcoin set a new record price, surpassing the high from the prior market cycle amid strong spot demand.

documents.title: Altcoins underperform as bitcoin dominance climbs
documents.summary: Bitcoin's share of total crypto market capitalisation rose to its highest level in three years as smaller tokens lagged.

documents.title: Country adds bitcoin to national reserves
documents.summary: A national government announced it will hold bitcoin as part of its strategic reserves, alongside gold and foreign currency.

documents.title: Tax authority issues guidance on reporting staking rewards
documents.summary: The tax agency clarified that staking rewards count as income when received and must be reported at fair market value.

documents.title: Hardware wallet maker discloses customer data leak
documents.summary: A hardware wallet company said a third-party breach exposed customer names and shipping addresses; no private keys were affected.

documents.title: Phishing campaign targets crypto users with fake airdrop sites
documents.summary: Security researchers warned of fraudulent airdrop pages that trick users into signing malicious wallet approvals.
